description: 과학기술정보통신부 국립중앙과학관_수상작정보 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 국립중앙과학관. 전국과학전람회 및 전국학생과학발명품경진대회 등 2023년 수상장 정보 자료입니다. 이 공공데이터는 제69회 전국과학전람회를 비롯한 여러 회차의 수상작 약 970건을 수록하고 있으며, 대회명, 주제, 소속기관, 작품 제목, 지도교사, 수상자, 수상명 등으로 구성되어 있습니다. 이를 통해 과학 교육 현장의... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 국립중앙과학관. Its tags are 과학교육, 전국과학전람회, 전국학생과학발명품경진대회, 과학주제, 작품제목. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-05-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
